title: REMOVE FRONT PILLAR GARNISH, DEFROSTER NOZZLE GARNISH, AND SAFETY PAD

content.text: Pry loose the clips with a screwdriver, and pull the garnish upward to remove it.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of front pillar garnish using screwdriver to pry loose clips on both left and right sides

content.text: Using a screwdriver, pry between the defroster nozzle garnish and safety pad.
Be careful not to scratch the safety pad.

content.description: Illustration showing use of screwdriver to pry between defroster nozzle garnish and safety pad

items: (a) Remove the seven screws and one bolt.
(d) Remove the left and right side defroster nozzle ducts.

content.description: Illustration showing safety pad assembly with seven screws and one bolt marked for removal

items: (e) Remove the instrument panel center register from the safety pad.
(f) Remove the left and right instrument panel side registers from the safety pad.
(g) Remove the side defroster retainer and defroster nozzle.

content.description: Illustration showing disassembled safety pad components including center register, side registers, defroster retainer and nozzle

content.text: INSTALL PARTS OF SAFETY PAD IN REVERSE SEQUENCE OF REMOVAL
